# AMP IT LLC

> Technology that moves your business forward. Charlotte-based managed IT, cybersecurity, and AI governance from a partner invested in your success.

AMP IT LLC is a Charlotte, NC-based managed service provider (MSP) offering all-inclusive per-user IT support, cybersecurity, and AI governance to law firms, CPA practices, financial advisory firms, and other professional service businesses locally and remotely across the United States. Founded 2026. Human support is available Monday–Friday, 7 AM–6 PM ET; automated monitoring runs 24/7 for covered systems.

## What We Do

- **Managed IT Services (MSP)** — 24/7 automated remote monitoring and management (RMM), automated patch management, endpoint protection, and proactive maintenance on published per-user monthly rates — all-inclusive, with no per-ticket charges or add-ons for standard services.
- **Cybersecurity** — Threat monitoring, email security (anti-phishing, anti-spam), endpoint detection and response (EDR), dark web credential monitoring, vulnerability management, firewall management, and incident response.
- **Cloud & Microsoft 365** — Setup, administration, and ongoing management of Microsoft 365, Teams, SharePoint, and Azure environments. Microsoft Partner.
- **Google Workspace** — Google Workspace administration and support. Google Partner.
- **Helpdesk Support** — Tier 1/2 remote support for covered users and systems. Human support is available Monday–Friday, 7 AM–6 PM ET; on-site service and emergency coverage depend on the agreed scope and selected plan.
- **Backup & Disaster Recovery** — Automated backup verification, disaster recovery planning, and business continuity documentation.
- **Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) & Zero Trust** — MFA deployment, conditional access policies, and zero trust architecture implementation.
- **Shadow AI Risk Management** — Detection and governance of unauthorized AI tool usage (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini used outside approved channels) that may expose confidential client data to FINRA, state bar, HIPAA, or cyber liability carrier violations.
- **AI Governance** — Policy frameworks and technical controls for generative AI usage within professional service firms.

## Who We Serve

Professional firms in the Charlotte, NC metropolitan area and businesses supported remotely across the United States, including:
- Law firms and legal practices (ABA technology ethics compliance)
- CPA and accounting firms
- Financial advisors and registered investment advisors (RIAs) — FINRA compliance
- Healthcare-adjacent professional offices — HIPAA compliance
- General small and mid-size businesses (typically 5–75 employees)

AMP IT is Charlotte-based and on-site-capable locally, with remote support available across the United States. It is not an anonymous national call center.

## Pricing

Published per-user monthly rates for standard covered services. Essential has a 5-user minimum. Standard managed IT agreements are 12 months.

Human support is available Monday–Friday, 7 AM–6 PM ET. Automated monitoring runs 24/7 for covered systems. Emergency coverage and response commitments depend on the selected plan and covered issue.

Current plan details: https://www.ampitsolutions.com/pricing/managed-it/

- **Essential** — $319/user/month (5 user minimum)
  - Remote monitoring & management — OS & software patching
  - 24/7 automated threat detection with managed response
  - Advanced email security & phishing protection
  - Automated backup — endpoints & cloud data
  - Helpdesk — Tier 1/2 remote support
  - User onboarding & offboarding
  - MFA enforcement + mobile device support
  - Monthly health report
  - Google Workspace & Microsoft 365 administration

- **Better** — $445/user/month (Ideal 10–40 users)
  - Everything in Essential, plus:
  - Backup verification & restore testing (monthly)
  - Web & DNS content filtering
  - Dark web monitoring (domain + exec emails)
  - Proactive maintenance windows
  - Quarterly Business Reviews

- **Best** — $499/user/month (Ideal 15–50 users)
  - Everything in Better, plus:
  - Virtual CIO — strategic IT planning & roadmapping
  - P1: 1-hr response / P2: 4-hr resolution SLA
  - Dedicated account manager
  - Vendor management
  - Disaster recovery planning + annual tabletop
  - Cybersecurity risk assessments
  - Compliance planning
  - After-hours emergency coverage included

## Service Area

On-site service throughout the greater Charlotte, NC metro — including Uptown, SouthPark, Ballantyne, Concord, Gastonia, and surrounding communities within ~50 miles of Charlotte — plus remote support across the United States.

## Credentials & Partnerships

- Microsoft Partner
- Google Partner

## Compliance Context

AMP IT helps regulated professional firms maintain technology compliance posture relevant to:
- FINRA cybersecurity rules and examination expectations
- State bar association technology ethics guidelines (ABA Model Rules)
- HIPAA security rule (for healthcare-adjacent clients)
- Cyber liability insurance carrier requirements (MFA enforcement, EDR, backup verification, incident response plans)
- Generative AI / Shadow AI governance for firms subject to client confidentiality obligations
